S0.scope: Evaluation primitives and frozen configuration only; no cohort/model acceptance is implied.

limitations: Event-run count is not the final incident prediction denominator.
Sampling is 5 or 15 minutes; no uniform 5-minute assumption.
Data are retrospective processed records with no arrival timestamps.
CGM/chest wall-clock alignment is a declared source assumption.
No archives were expanded; features read directly from CSV members.
Quarantined clocks are not assigned labels by optimizing disease prediction.
Regression acceptance only; incident-event risk requires separate evaluation.
Missing wearable values are allowed in the model; availability subgroups must be reported.
Processed-record arrival times are unavailable.
Retrospective event definition with 5/15-minute reference sampling.
Coverage is conditional on a reference-observable eligible decision opportunity.
Not a clinical alarm or an intervention benefit study.

S3.coverage_definition: Supported elapsed intervals with finite scores at BOTH endpoints / observed elapsed reference intervals (gaps <=7.5 minutes); macro over subjects.
limitations: CGM versus chest clock remains a source assumption; +/-5 minute sensitivity is separate.
Low/High censored values are classification labels only.
Quality screening is an engineering heuristic, not a clinically validated SQI.
Common-channel validation conditions threshold selection; missing test data count against end-to-end event recall and coverage.
